verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins is the plugin/skill ecosystem for Codex, itself a coding agent; the evidence only shows Codex connecting to or wiring MCP servers as a client (e.g., plugin-creator adds 'MCP server wiring for the plugin'), which is the client-side role, not Codex itself being served via an official MCP server endpoint. No evidence of a 'codex mcp serve' mode or hosted MCP endpoint that other agents connect to.
